newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 5.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on March 5:
WASHINGTON - The Senate rejected a proposed balanced budget amendment to the Constitution by a single vote for the second time in three years.

WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan strongly supported creation of a presidentially appointed commission to set the size of the annual cost-of-living adjustment in federal benefits and taxes.
WASHINGTON - Independent prosecutor Kenneth Starr has subpoenaed the White House for information on 20 individuals and entities connected to Indonesian financial conglomerate Lippo Group.
WASHINGTON - Controversial fund-raiser John Huang used his senior position in government at least twice over the past two years to seek concrete help from a member of Congress.

WASHINGTON - Swiss banks have been slow to return property held by victims of the Holocaust in Swiss accounts, but pressure by Jewish groups and Senate Banking Chairman Alfonse D'Amato is finally leading to some progress.
ROSLIN, SCOTLAND - Scottish researcher Ian Wilmut has become the focus of worldwide attention after he and his team successfully produced the first clone ever from an adult mammal.
